test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.**

Do any of you ________ (object to) the decision?
solution: The correct answer is **"approve of."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** "object"** means to express opposition or disapproval. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद करना, उसके विरुद्घ होना) • **Example**: *Many people object to the new tax.* • The antonym of **"object"** would be a word that means **to express agreement or approval**. • **"Approve of"** is the most appropriate antonym in this context, as it means to express a favorable opinion or consent. (किसी को पसंद करना या उससे संतुष्‍ट होना; स्‍वीकार्य समझना) • **Example:** *His father didn’t approve of him becoming a dancer.* • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**: *Do any of you **approve of**__ the decision?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2) "repine to"** means to complain or express dissatisfaction, which is not the opposite of "object." (शिकायत करना या असंतोष व्यक्त करना) • **Option 3) "demonstrate" **means to show or prove, which is not the opposite of "object." (प्रमाण देकर सिद्घ करना) • **Option 4) "withstand to" **means to endure or resist, which is not the opposite of "object." (सहन या बरदाश्‍त कर सकना) 162:Tc1a, The correct answer is **"When you travelling with us".**
